Title: Generally Available: GitHub Copilot for Azure

Body.Content: GitHub Copilot for Azure is now generally available, bringing disruption-free cloud development, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) support, and intelligent diagnostics to streamline your workflow. With features to help you create deployments with Bicep and Terraform, efficient issue identification and resolution, and deep integration with Azure resources, GitHub Copilot for Azure empowers developers to build, manage, and troubleshoot applications effortlessly. Whether you're designing resilient architectures, enhancing code quality with real-time recommendations, or leveling up your Azure expertise, GitHub Copilot for Azure acts as your trusted assistant, ensuring productivity and efficiency at every step. Embrace the future of cloud development with GitHub Copilot for Azure and transform the way you code.
